item.title: How has the ceasefire in Russian-occupied Oleshky been unfolding?
item.description:
A Russian drone strike killed at least 14 Ukrainians at a Dnipro train station Thursday, while a US-brokered localized ceasefire in an occupied city held for a third day, highlighting Washington’s uneven progress in ending the nearly five-year war. Both Kyiv and Moscow praised US first lady Melania Trump for helping secure the truce in Oleshky, which some warned Russia would use for military resupply and propaganda efforts , as the conflict’s death toll mounts elsewhere. Still, the events have made the first lady more popular with Ukrainians than her husband, who has blamed Kyiv for high gas prices, ahead of US-led negotiations next month: “ We like Melania more !” one Ukrainian said. — Brendan Ruberry

item.title: Wyoming Teams With Trump Administration to Expedite Energy, Industrial Projects
item.description:
At a campaign rally on Tuesday, President Donald Trump said his administration is going to dismantle restrictions on methane , one of the most common and potent planet-warming greenhouse gases . The new rule, proposed by the Environmental Protection Agency in response to complaints from the oil and gas industry, revises a Biden-era rule targeting methane leaks and would relax methane monitoring and emission-control requirements. The agency has planned to repeal these rules for months, saying that they posed a “monumental threat” to the economy and an “undue burden” on the oil and gas industry. item.title: Dolores Huerta’s legacy is the generations of labor activists she inspired from the frontlines
item.description:

He is the author of “ The Strikers of Coachella: A Rank-and-File History of the UFW Movement .” The only time I have been arrested was with Dolores Huerta in 2004. item.title: Sir Patrick Stewart: Actor who moved effortlessly between Star Trek and Shakespeare
item.description:
Following this week's news of Patrick Stewart's death, the Defector staff convened to remember some of our favorite performances by him. The Simpsons Patrick Stewart is one of our most recognizable forces in pop culture: the kind of star who could be identified just by his profile, a rare feat of notoriety in any era. Every bit of him is iconic, but it’s his voice that truly makes him the performer he was. It's only right, then, that he became a memorable voice actor in animated work.

item.title: Open Thread
item.description:
Wait! Don’t carve that pumpkin! Haven’t you heard? The newest Halloween horror isn’t gummies, goblins, or razor blades in apples. (Who still even gives out apples?) It’s salmonella from pumpkins. If that seems made-up, it’s not . In East Texas, a 4-month-old girl participated in her day care’s “seasonal activity” of putting pumpkin guts in a plastic bag. The next day, she started vomiting, and by noon, she was admitted to the hospital. She had a very rough time of it, but thankfully recovered and is fine. Her mom took to social media to tell others. She wasn’t fearmongering, just shocked. But pretty soon, salmonella fears were spreading like a fecal-orally transmitted infectious disease. Then came the calls to ban pumpkin-carving for kids. Even though this awful thing happened . . . one time. In one place. In a country of 343 million people—and about 1.5 billion pounds of annual pumpkin…

item.title: US interest rates held steady and economy grows - what it means for you
item.description:
The US economy grew faster than expected this summer, new data showed, but the strong economic reading right before next week’s midterm elections is unlikely to cheer Americans worried about rising inflation, analysts said. “ Voters don’t vote on GDP ,” a Republican strategist told Bloomberg; many are still struggling with surging gas prices that have driven down US President Donald Trump’s approval rating to new lows. More consumers are spending more than they bring in, Navy Federal Credit Union’s chief economist wrote: “There’s clearly strain on a lot of Americans .” Though oil prices retreated this week as Washington and Tehran pursued tentative diplomacy, refining capacity remains limited , and the White House has signaled it could resume strikes on Iran after midterms. — Brendan Ruberry
